# Check that commands in cmd install to $GOROOT/bin.
# Verifies golang.org/issue/32674.
go list -f '{{.Target}}' cmd/go/main
stdout $GOROOT${/}bin${/}go$GOEXE

# A build tool is a package the go command links, with no target of its own;
# its name under $GOTOOLDIR is a link to the go command.
go list -f '{{.Name}} [{{.Target}}]' cmd/compile
stdout '^compile \[\]$'
